_comment: Units of each currency per 1 USD, for the salary bracket's cross-currency comparison (ADR-0117). A committed table, not a live lookup, so a search never depends on a third-party call at request time. `as_of` is surfaced in the UI beside the filter — if it goes stale the user can see that it has. Refresh by replacing `rates` and `as_of` together; a rate without its date is the defect this file exists to avoid. A currency absent from `rates` is not converted and its jobs are left out of a cross-currency bracket rather than silently compared at 1:1.
source: exchangerate-api.com (open.er-api.com, updated 2026-09-07T00:02Z), cross-checked against the ECB via frankfurter.dev (2026-09-04): 28 of 33 currencies agreed within 2%; the rest are carried by only one source.
